description: Reverts a completed task to needsAction and clears its completed timestamp — the undo for complete_task. Works on hidden tasks too (tasks cleared with clear_completed_tasks): reopening un-hides them. Cannot resurrect a deleted task — deletion is permanent. Returns the updated task.

task_id.description: The task id — from list_tasks, get_task or create_task output.

tasklist_id.description: The task list id — from list_tasklists or create_tasklist output. "@default" addresses the user's default list.

name: reopen_task
title: Reopen a task
